definitions.gloss: coming and going, back and forth, traffic
definitions.explanation: The movement of people going to and from a place. Refers to physical traffic of people or the ongoing mutual visits or exchanges between people or places.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{行|い}き{来|き}が{多|おお}い{通|とお}りだ。
examples.english: It's a street with a lot of foot traffic.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{国|くに}の{間|あいだ}で{人|ひと}の{行|い}き{来|き}が{盛|さか}んになった。
examples.english: The movement of people between the two countries has become active.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してからも{前|まえ}の{町|まち}の{友人|ゆうじん}とは{行|い}き{来|き}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: Even after moving, I continue to visit back and forth with friends from my previous town.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes both physical movement of people in a location and ongoing mutual visits between people. Can be used with する to mean "to go back and forth" or "to visit each other."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}の{行|い}き{来|き}: foot traffic, people coming and going
- {行|い}き{来|き}がある: to have contact/exchanges
- {行|い}き{来|き}する: to come and go, to visit back and forth
- {行|い}き{来|き}が{激|はげ}しい: heavy traffic (of people)
